retainedReference.title: Drottningholm Palace, main building and connected courtyard wings

pictures.author: Rosser1954 (rotation by Finavon)
pictures.observed: Actually viewed1280px full lake elevation: yellow central three-story block, pale pilasters/window bands and ground arches; tall dark green-gray hipped roof with two raised ends/dormers/chimneys and central slender roof lantern; lower side ranges/intermediate pavilions, two domed ends. Lake terrace/statuary remain context.

pictures.author: Allsong
pictures.observed: Actually viewed960x1280 portrait garden view: central three-story yellow facade/pale paired pilasters, three middle arched openings, hipped green roof with two raised ends/dormers and slender central roof feature. Long formal garden/fountain/hedges are independent context.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Connected mapped exterior of Drottningholm Palace: pale-yellow rendered three-story central block, cream pilasters/window surrounds/arched lake-side ground openings, green-gray hipped central roof and raised roof pavilions, low courtyard wings, four intermediate pavilions, northern chapel dome and matching southern domed end. Preserve both mapped open courtyards and all independent theater/outbuildings. One actual recessed lake-side central doorway and simple threshold. No furnished rooms, copied coats of arms, flag graphics, statues or garden reconstruction.
